source_notes: Static bull-market levels for the BTC Thesis Dashboard. Edit this file to move MRI, the $100k gate, the valuation top, the weekly invalidation, or the first-support price without an app change. Live prints (True Market Mean, short-term holder cost basis, 200-day average, STH Q75/Q90 profit-taking bands, Mayer 1.5×, STH-MVRV, long-term holder supply share, cost-basis cluster) come from bull_watch.json, which refresh_bull_watch.py fills from Bitview. Dollar fallbacks below are used only when that live feed is missing. They are not a second live print.

levels.label: Weekly invalidation
levels.note: A weekly close under this level invalidates the bull read.

levels.label: First support to defend (cleared confirm)
levels.note: Cleared confirm from 2026-09-24. First support to defend on a pullback. The live 50-week average is a separate line. Chart line still starts at the May 10 2026 peak.

levels.label: STH Q75 (profit-taking band)
levels.note: Static fallback only, used when the live STH-MVRV quantile band is unavailable. Research anchor was about $87k. Check's model overheats several times in a bull (local tops).

levels.label: STH Q90 (profit-taking band)
levels.note: Static fallback only, used when the live STH-MVRV quantile band is unavailable. Research anchor was about $104k. Q90 means only about 10% of days were hotter. Check's model overheats several times in a bull (local tops).

levels.label: Check MRI midpoint
levels.note: Static. Drifting toward $95–100k over about 3 months. Not a live series.

levels.label: $100k recovery to excitement
levels.note: Recovery-to-excitement gate. Expect failed tries before a hold.

levels.label: Mayer multiple
levels.note: Not a price. The live dollar level is this multiple times the 200-day average.

levels.label: Valuation-range top
levels.note: Check valuation-range top. First big long-term-holder sell zone.

levels.label: STH-MVRV running hot
levels.note: Top-side heat. Warning when STH-MVRV is at or above this. The buy-the-dip card still owns the below-1 side. On Bitview the 2024 peak was about 1.43.

levels.label: LTH supply-share decline
levels.note: Warning when long-term-holder supply as a share of total supply falls by at least this many percentage points over 90 finished days.

levels.label: MOVE stress line
levels.note: Stress reference. Shown with the fragile line and the recession line.
